title: Dope – Lime Smash
description: Introducing the exhilarating DOPE Lime Smash Crazy Strong, a premium selection from the renowned DOPE brand. This product is a game-changer for those who seek a potent and zesty nicotine experience. Crafted for the bold and the brave, DOPE Lime Smash delivers an invigorating burst of flavour coupled with a formidable nicotine kick.
